properties.value: Automatic membrane filter press (PP plates, PTFE cloth, ≈ 70 chambers of 1,500 mm) with a 1.5 pore-volume displacement cake wash: 90 % of the cake liquor to T-304 and the concentrator, ≈ 0.65 t/d H₂SO₄ left in the washed cake (decanter V1.1: 14.2 t/d); gated on M1, decanter with repulp wash the fallback
properties.note: D-A300-07 | D-A300-07: C-301 becomes an automatic membrane filter press with a displacement cake wash as the Route 2 separation base case (bases CW1–CW8, FEED-PE-CAL-032 V1.2): press cake ≈ 4.6 t at 15 % solids (10–20 %), 1.5 pore volumes of process water (≈ 4.0 t per batch), 90 % of the cake liquor displaced to T-304 — H₂SO₄ leaving with the cake falls from 14.2 to ≈ 0.65 t/d and ≈ 13.6 t/d more reaches the concentrator (CAL-033 V1.1, rated 150 t/d); P-303 becomes the AODD press feed pump, T-304 65 m³, P-306 15 m³/h. Supersedes the decanter envelope of RA4; the decanter with a repulp wash is the fallback. A-1000 is not re-balanced (CW8): its extra capacity is margin for M2 / M3. Approved in review by QFL 2026-09-27.

properties.value: Polypropylene plates, PTFE or PP multifilament cloth; PVDF / PTFE-lined manifolds (HOLD QH6)
properties.note: D-A300-08: replaces the decanter material ruling | D-A300-08: C-301 is a membrane filter press (D-A300-07): the MAT-002 decanter ruling (Hastelloy C-276 with WC / ceramic hardfacing) no longer applies. Approve the FEED-PE-DAT-102 V1.2 materials: PP plates, PTFE / PP cloth, PVDF / PTFE-lined manifolds. Stale-text clean-up A1, approved by QFL 2026-09-29.
